rubric: Frame and assumptions stated (place, days, travellers, budget level); days grouped by area with 2 to 4 stops, times and the transfer between stops.
Rest built in (a slow afternoon, naps for small children, an easy first day); the must-see on day 1 or 2.
Book-before, costs as ranges, and check lines (opening days, holidays, documents, safety source) present.
No invented opening hours, prices, train times or restaurant names; dishes or neighbourhoods instead of unsure names.
Rainy-day and tired-day alternatives in one line each.
